Name: herdr agents
Author: Tim van der Hoorn
Description: Live herdr agent status on your Stream Deck.

Actions.Name: Agent Slot
Actions.Tooltip: Shows one herdr agent. Slots number themselves left-to-right, top-to-bottom; press = focus, hold = pin.

Actions.Name: Pager
Actions.Tooltip: Auto: jumps to the next blocked/done agent when any need attention, otherwise pages the grid. Or dedicate it to Next / Prev / Attention.

Actions.Name: Summary
Actions.Tooltip: Counts of working / blocked / done / idle agents. Press to raise the terminal on the focused agent.

Actions.Name: Toggle Idle
Actions.Tooltip: Show or hide idle agents in the slot grid.

Actions.Name: Agent Input
Actions.Tooltip: Send keys (enter, esc, y, ctrl+c…) or a canned prompt to the agent herdr has focused.
